falsifiable_hypothesis: Hierarchical common/deviation refinement helps most when the underlying orientation-contrast signal is itself reliable. The positive-part global James-Stein factor is already a parameter-free estimate of that reliability, so it can gate the hierarchical innovation without a new weight menu.
component_rule: Orientation A is leave-one-whole-patient bagged geometry. Orientation B starts from interpolated-jackknife geometry. No A/B prediction averaging occurs.
shrinkage_rule: From the three authenticated inner whole-patient bandwidth-0.7 OOF contrast vectors compute theta_global and theta_hier exactly as in octant_hierarchical_js_hedge. Let a_global=max(0,1-22*sigma2/sum(cbar^2)) be the positive-part global James-Stein reliability. Set theta=(1-a_global)*theta_global+a_global*theta_hier. Apply q_B=q_B,interpolated_jackknife-0.5*theta. Thus hierarchical refinement is exactly zero when the global orientation signal is judged unreliable and grows continuously with the same reliability estimate. No free hedge parameter, target/fold outer routing, or protected data is used.

task_contract.ab_rule: average separately costed A/B losses; never average predictions
